title: CI Job Evidence v1
description: Canonical CI job evidence produced by the CI evidence orchestrator. Captures per-job metadata including status, platform, validation surfaces, referenced artifacts, and structured failure summaries.

run_id.description: Stable identifier for the parent CI run.

job_id.description: Stable identifier for this CI job. For GitHub Actions: job name or matrix-derived id. For local: sequential index.

runner_os.description: Operating system of the runner (e.g., ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, or local OS).

runner_arch.description: CPU architecture of the runner (e.g., x86_64, aarch64).

conclusion.description: Job conclusion. Null if job has not completed.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of job completion. Omitted if still running.

commands.description: Summarized command surface executed by this job. Must not contain secrets, tokens, or raw private file contents.

validation_surfaces.description: Validation surfaces exercised by this job (e.g., ['schema_validation', 'pyright', 'pytest']).

referenced_artifacts.description: Artifact IDs referenced by this job.

referenced_schema_validations.description: Schema validation results referenced by this job.

referenced_test_receipts.description: Test receipt paths referenced by this job.

failure_summary.description: Machine-readable failure summary. Empty string for successful jobs. Must not contain raw secrets or private file contents.

telemetry_redaction_notes.description: Statement that no raw secrets, credentials, private file contents, raw prompts, or private repository contents were emitted in this evidence.
